status: frozen after V19BD passed and while V19W was still running, before reading a V19X gas-state result, selecting a covariant action, operator, source activation, wavelength, coupling, phase or polarization, opening a lensing or halo payload, or changing gravity physics
purpose: Turn the hypothesis that an additional gravitational metric mode has a wavelength longer than a star system into an action-level admission gate. Preserve the useful Solar-to-galaxy scale separation while prohibiting an unconserved filtered source, a free halo-equivalent wave, a per-object wavelength, or a replay of the failed linear isotropic operator.

physical_postulate.statement: The physical metric may contain an additional baryon-forced mode whose universal correlation length or wavelength exceeds a planetary system, so its constant and uniform-gradient pieces are locally unobservable while its tidal curvature can change over galactic and cluster baselines.
not_assumed: that ordinary Newtonian or GR near-field gravity is itself one monochromatic traveling wave
that wavelength determines amplitude, sign, phase, polarization, source or attraction
that a free cosmological wave may be adjusted to imitate an object halo
that a wavelength may be inferred separately from each galaxy or cluster

covariant_inputs: isotropic pressure and trace-free stress in a declared covariant matter frame
causal assembly or propagation state if V19X makes it identifiable
source_state_requirements.projection_warning: The V19BA-V19BD line-of-sight luminosity-current moments are measurement proxies, not yet a complete local four-dimensional tensor or an action source.
source_state_requirements.filter_warning: A curved-spacetime coarse-grained or retarded tensor is not assumed to be covariantly conserved merely because the microscopic baryonic stress-energy is conserved.
source_state_requirements.pending_input: V19W must complete and V19X must supply target-blind gas thermodynamic and uncertainty maps before one combined source state can be admitted.

closed_controls: linear isotropic wavelength-only transfer from Sigma V3C
positive-spectrum linear infrared enhancement from Sigma V3B
rational infrared enhancement with a negative-residue massive pole
identity-projector point-source Yukawa or STVG-MOG realization
aether, Proca, massive-spin-two, material-memory or gauge-tidal carrier replay
mechanism_boundary.only_admissible_next_class: A nonlinear, baryon-forced, source-state-sensitive interaction derived from one diffeomorphism-invariant action, with the GR quadratic propagator retained and no freely adjustable homogeneous halo state.

illustrative_scale_check.literal_wavelength_relation: lambda is 2 pi times the correlation length
illustrative_scale_check.parameter_status: illustrative dimensional check only; neither 6 kpc nor its associated wavelength is selected as a Sigma constant

must_fail_if: the proposed added metric source is written on the Einstein-equation right-hand side without a conservation proof or a complete action variation
the source phase, direction, polarization, wavelength or amplitude is fitted to an individual object
the homogeneous solution can carry an arbitrary halo-shaped state unrelated to baryonic initial data
the same physical metric does not determine both massive trajectories and photon null geodesics
the proposal changes only the name, strength, length or exponent of a closed linear isotropic, Yukawa, Proca, aether or spin-two mechanism

claim_boundary: Passing V19BE shows only that the long-wave premise has been stated consistently enough to constrain the next derivation; it is not evidence that the extra mode exists.
The numerical calculation demonstrates scale separation, not compliance with Cassini, Mercury, pulsar timing, gravitational-wave speed, radiative-loss or PPN constraints.
No action, field content, source activation, coupling, wavelength, phase, polarization or universal Sigma constant is selected.
The collisionless source evidence comes from two spent merging clusters and has not been compared with a lensing residual.
No gas, lensing, halo or holdout payload is read by this protocol.
